prompt: A habit tracker that demands a full 30-minute session daily collapses whenever life gets busy, even though the person happily does 5 minutes on those days when allowed. What design change best fits this evidence?

options.text: Raise the daily demand to 45 minutes to increase commitment
Delete the tracker, because tracking never helps
Count only perfect weeks and discard the rest
Set a small 'floor' version that counts on busy days, with the full session as the standard on normal days, so the chain survives hard weeks

explanation: An all-or-nothing target turns a busy day into a broken habit. A defined minimum keeps the cue-routine loop alive through hard periods, and full sessions resume when time returns.
